newsitem.title: USA: Comair, AirWays in code-sharing pact.
newsitem.headline: Comair, AirWays in code-sharing pact.

text.p: Comair Holdings Inc and AirWays Corp said Wednesday that they have signed a letter of intent to begin a code-sharing relationship.
The arrangement, said the companies, would connect the 23 cities served by AirTran Airways and the nine cities COMAIR serves in Florida through Orlando International Airport.
No start date for this service has been established, said the airlines, but they hope that code-share operations will be in place for the summer travel season.
Final implementation of this arrangement, they said, is subject to various approvals and acceptance of a definitive agreement by both companies.
